formulas.description: Quarterly firm EBITDA from Scenario_Drivers!C7:V7
Opening covenant EBITDA = firm_ebitda + rent_norm + integration_addback
covenant_ebitda[q] = firm_ebitda[q] - one_time_charges[q] + covenant_addbacks[q] (SB_Base!C14)
Quarterly cash interest — term/DDTL avg-balance × (SOFR + spread)/4 + revolver_beg × (SOFR + spread)/4 + unused fees. SB_Base!C22/D22.
formulas.note: Cyclic dependency: rev_beg is the beginning-of-period revolver balance. Converged within SCC-CASHFLOW-INTEREST-REVOLVER.

formulas.description: Cash flow from operations = net_income + D&A + fee_amort + deferred_tax_adj − delta_nwc. SB_Base!C52.
formulas.note: Cyclic via interest. Resolved within SCC-CASHFLOW-INTEREST-REVOLVER.

formulas.description: Revolver draw/repay — IF-chain: forced_target, repay_all, cash_shortfall, cash_surplus. SB_Base!C59/D59, C60/D60.
end_term = max(0, max(0, beg_term - scheduled_amort) + ecf_sweep). SB_Base!C76.
formulas.expression_or_function_ref: max(0, max(0, beg_term - min(term_amort_q, beg_term)) + ecf_sweep)

formulas.description: end_ddtl = max(0, beg_ddtl + draw_q + amort_q). SB_Base!C77.
end_cash = beg_cash + cfo + cfi + cff. SB_Base!C67.

variable_binding.cff: sponsor_contrib + ddtl_draw + term_amort + ddtl_amort + rev_draw + rev_repay + ecf_sweep

formulas.description: net_leverage = (term + ddtl + revolver - min(cash, netting_cap)) / ltm_covenant_ebitda. Covenant definition.
Max opening debt = covenant_ebitda × max_leverage_multiple. Max leverage from credit agreement; financing grid step-down rule (>15% single-parent) is a coverage limit.
formulas.note: COVERAGE_LIMIT: financing grid step-down rule (>15% single-parent exposure) not modelled; requires policy_owner confirmation

formulas.description: sponsor_equity = EV - term_loan - seller_rollover - opening_cash + financing_fees + buyer_tx_expenses
exit_ev = ltm_4q_ebitda × exit_multiple. OR!E4.
exit_net_debt = term_loan_exit + ddtl_exit + revolver_exit - cash_exit. OR!F4.
exit_equity = exit_ev - exit_net_debt. OR!G4.
gross_moic = (exit_equity × (1 - mip_pct) × sponsor_ownership_pct) / sponsor_invested. OR!K4.
Sponsor dated cash flows: entry equity out, exit equity in
gross_xirr = XIRR([-sponsor_invested, 0..., +sponsor_proceeds], [entry_date, ..., exit_date]). Newton-Raphson, ACT/365. OR!L4.
Finds max entry EV s.t. IRR ≥ 14% and MOIC ≥ 2.0×. Implemented as bisection over run_lbo(). Binding constraint reported in output.
Sources = Uses check at closing
Opening balance sheet assets = liabilities + equity
Per-quarter balance sheet check: assets = liabilities + equity

variable_binding.assets: cash + ar + wip + prepaids + fixed_assets + goodwill
variable_binding.liabilities: term_loan + ddtl + revolver + ap + accruals + deferred_rev

rule_switches.description: Determines revolver draw/repay each quarter based on cash position relative to floor and optional forced target. SB_Base!C59/D59, C60/D60.

branches.output_expression: draw = max(0, forced_target - prior_rev); repay = -max(0, prior_rev - forced_target)

branches.condition: pre_cash >= cash_floor AND repay_all == 0 AND forced_target < 0

branches.output_expression: draw = min(cash_floor - pre_cash, revolver_commitment - prior_rev); repay = 0

rule_switches.multi_branch_behavior: RS-REV-FORCED takes priority; then RS-REV-REPAY-ALL; then RS-REV-AUTO-SURPLUS / RS-REV-AUTO-DRAW are mutually exclusive

rule_switches.description: Annual excess cash flow sweep — fires Dec-31 quarters only. Rate determined by net leverage tier. SB_Base!E63/I63/M63/Q63/U63.
rule_switches.multi_branch_behavior: RAISE_AMBIGUOUS (branches are mutually exclusive by construction)

rule_switches.description: 163(j) interest deduction cap — limits deductible interest to 30% of reported EBITDA; excess carries forward. SB_Base!C116.

branches.output_expression: deductible_interest = 0.30 * rep_ebitda; carryforward = abs(cash_interest) + prior_carryforward - 0.30 * rep_ebitda

rule_switches.description: Financing grid: selects applicable leverage / pricing tier based on deal characteristics. Step-down rule for >15% single-parent exposure is a coverage limit.

branches.output_expression: COVERAGE_LIMIT: step-down terms not policy-specified; block MN-DEBT-CAPACITY until policy_owner confirms

coverage_limits.effect: Step-down branch is a fixture placeholder. Policy owner must confirm the exact step-down rule before RS-FG-STEP-DOWN-PLACEHOLDER can be evaluated.

Opening balance sheet assets = liabilities + equity.
Per-quarter balance sheet: assets = liabilities + equity.
model_controls.unknown_condition: any input_id unresolved in that period

model_controls.description: Revolver balance must remain within [0, commitment] (commitment = 7.5 MM).
Interest expense sign must be negative (cash outflow).
Net leverage must remain at or below covenant limit each quarter. Breach does NOT block the computation — it flags FAIL for IC review.
model_controls.pass_condition: net leverage ≤ covenant limit every quarter
model_controls.note: Covenant breach is advisory for monitoring; does not block Supported Price or MOIC computation

coverage_limits.description: The cash-flow / interest / revolver cycle is modelled (cyclic_component_models) but not emitted as an executable cyclic_component_solver_config: PANTA requires every name on an equation's right-hand side to be a component member id, while member ids must resolve to model nodes, and our node ids contain hyphens. Quarterly interest, CFO and revolver therefore do not converge inside the runtime.
